meta.title: Shipment & Compliance Document Upload: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Open an ASN as a vendor and attach the packing list, e-way bill, and LR/AWB documents.
Compare the capability on a Growth-plan tenant and an Enterprise-plan tenant using the same vendor role and workflow.
Observe whether the Shipment & Compliance Document Upload capability is absent or refused specifically because of the tenant plan.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open an ASN as a vendor and attach the packing list, e-way bill, and LR/AWB documents.; Compare the capability on a Growth-plan tenant and an Enterprise-plan tenant using the same vendor role and workflow.; Observe whether the Shipment & Compliance Document Upload capability is absent or refused specifically because of the tenant plan.

args.need: sign in as the vendor, open an ASN on a Growth-plan tenant, verify whether Shipment & Compliance Document Upload is absent or refused, then repeat the same upload steps on an Enterprise-plan tenant and report the results

steps.note: The catalog cannot navigate ASN workflows, inspect plan entitlements, or perform this capability-specific vendor comparison.
If the tester reaches the relevant Enterprise screen, confirm that the capability label is visible; this does not establish Growth-plan absence or successful document uploads.
